item.description: Community Care Network honored thirty-eight employees for service milestones in Rutland. Susan Warner was recognized for forty years of dedicated service. The agency serves more than thirty five hundred people annually in Rutland County.

The twenty twenty-six Gift of Life Marathon Blood Drive honors radio broadcaster Nanci Gordon, a longtime blood donor. Four donation events are scheduled in Rutland and Castleton this December. Donors of all blood types are urged to make appointments to support the holiday blood supply.

The butternut tree was expected to nearly disappear from Vermont by twenty twelve due to disease. Martin Kratt found hundreds of young and mature butternut trees on his Isle La Motte property. Researchers are now studying these trees to learn how they are surviving.

Vermont Fish & Wildlife extended the bear hunting season by a month and added a second bear tag despite overwhelming public opposition. Critics say the department ignored community concerns and scientific evidence. Some suggest mandating bear-proof containers to reduce conflicts.
